text:
Luca (Contractor): Hi team, start date next Wed. My SSN card is delayed in the mail (applied replacement). Can I still complete I-9? Also how do contractors enroll in benefits?

Rina (People Ops): Welcome Luca. For I-9 you can present a photo ID + the SSN replacement receipt as a List B doc; then bring the SSN card once received (I-9 Section 2 re-verification). We'll note the exception. For benefits: contractors don't get standard medical but eligible for commuter and wellness stipend if contracted for 6+ months. Fill contractor intake in BambooHR.

Luca (Contractor): Okay thanks. Do I need an appointment to use the onsite kiosk or can I use a remote notary? I want to avoid coming to office before my first day.

Ben (People Ops): You can use remote notary OR an HQ kiosk. Remote voucher available for new contractors; reply if you want us to reserve. If remote, make sure the notary records the replacement receipt image.

notary-bot: Remote voucher CODE: RW-CON-07 valid 7 days. Kiosk slots Tue 16:00-17:00, Wed 09:00-10:00. Reply 'reserve kiosk' or 'send voucher'.

Luca (Contractor): Send voucher pls. Also flagged by Payroll Bot that W-9 not submitted? I filled one but not sure it went through.

Payroll Bot: W-9 status: not received. Please upload signed W-9 to the contractor portal or email payroll@redwood.ai. Payments may be delayed until W-9 is on file.

Rina (People Ops): I'll send the voucher and re-send the W-9 link. Complete both by EOD Tue so we can clear onboarding holds. Note: if the SSN card still missing by day 5 we'll place a temporary payroll hold until re-verification is complete.

Luca (Contractor): Got it. Voucher and W-9 link received. I'll do remote notarization tonight and upload W-9.
